newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Catalonia allots 6.5 bln ptas in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Catalonia allots 6.5 bln ptas in bonds.

text.p: Spain's Catalonia regional government (Generalitat de Catalunya) said on Wednesday it allotted a total of 6.5 billion pesetas in five- and 10-year bonds at a public auction.
Yields fell sharply against the previous auction on October 23. Results are as follows:
ISSUE Yield Pvs Price Pvs Bid Allocated
NOTE - * In both cases new tranches of old issues were offered.
Moody's long-term debt rating for Generalitat de Catalunya is A1. At the end of June 1996 the region's total debt was 1,018 billion pesetas of which 257 billion pesetas was in bonds.
